docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Eight lectures that Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941) gave in English at Harvard University and in England in 1912–13, most of them first given to the students of his school at Śāntiniketan: an account of the outlook of the Upaniṣads and of the Buddha as he lived it, on the relation of the individual to the universe, the soul, the problem of evil, the self, and realisation in love, in action, in beauty and in the infinite. Published by Macmillan in 1913.
